cleavage_agent.evidence: Briefly, beads were re-suspended in 50 μl of provided lysis buffer and proteins were denatured, reduced and alkylated during 10 min at 60°C. The resulting slurries (beads and lysis buffer) were transferred to dedicated cartridges and proteins were digested with a Trypsin/LysC mix for 2 hours at 37°C.
